Synopsis:
    Singapore's parliament is set to debate ministerial salaries, unchanged since a 36% cut in 2012. PM Lawrence Wong and Coordinating Minister Chan Chun Sing will respond to a review committee's recommendations. Singapore pays the world's highest political salaries (PM at S$2.2M/year), justified as anti-corruption and talent-attraction measures. A 2023 review was deferred due to economic uncertainty and is now being addressed. Inflation at 2% and a median income of S$5,775 heighten public sensitivity around the issue.
